Package index

Package overview

pod5R pod5R-package
An R interface to pod5 file format by Oxford Nanopore

File access

Open and close POD5 readers and inspect file-level information.

open_pod5()
Opens POD5 file through the native C API and stores read batch boundaries.
close_pod5()
Close a native POD5 reader
read_pod5_info()
Read POD5 file information

Reads and sequencing runs

Retrieve read identifiers, read metadata, sequencing run information, and optional signal data.

read_pod5_ids()
Read POD5 read identifiers
read_pod5()
Read POD5 metadata and signals (optionally)
read_pod5_runs()
Read POD5 sequencing run information

Signal extraction

Extract raw or calibrated signal and map Dorado split reads to intervals in their parent POD5 signals.

extract_pod5_signal()
Extract selected POD5 signal vectors
extract_pod5_signal_dorado()
Maps Dorado split-read identifiers back to their original POD5 parents using explicitly provided SAM/BAM tags. Returns the signal for the corresponding basecalled interval in acquisition order.

Batch processing

Process reads in batches using a supplied function.

process_pod5()
Process POD5 reads in groups
